description: Source code defining API routes/endpoints for the backend of a financial tracking system using FastAPI. Contains route definitions for authentication, transactions, categories, budgets, dashboard, and reports, with related imports and dependencies.

methods.name: register(user: UserCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles user registration by creating a new user record after confirming email and username are unique.

methods.name: login(form_data: UserLogin, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials and issues a JWT token.

methods.name: get_profile(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns the current authenticated user's profile information.

methods.name: list_categories(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Lists all categories for the current user.

methods.name: create_category(cat: CategoryIn, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
update_category(category_id: int, cat: CategoryIn, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Updates an existing category identified by its ID.

methods.name: delete_category(category_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Deletes a category specified by its ID.

methods.name: list_transactions( skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), start_date: Optional[date] = Query(None), end_date: Optional[date] = Query(None), category_id: Optional[int] = Query(None), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of transactions for the current user, optionally filtered by date range and category.

methods.name: create_transaction(tx: TransactionIn, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new financial transaction entry.

methods.name: update_transaction(transaction_id: int, tx: TransactionIn, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Updates details of an existing transaction.

methods.name: delete_transaction(transaction_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
set_budget(budget: BudgetIn, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Sets or updates the budget for a specific category and period.

methods.name: get_budgets(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves all budgets for the current user.

methods.name: get_dashboard(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Provides an overview of the user's financial data, including totals and top transactions.

methods.name: generate_report(request: ReportRequest, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Generates a financial report grouped by category or month.
